tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.56
§ Giddel = "very great"
1) the head of a family of temple slaves returning from exile with Zerubbabel
2) the head of the descendants of Solomon's servants returning from exile with Zerubbabel

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Giddel, the name of one of the Nethinim, also of one of 'Solomon's servants'
